Do not model it as a user action.\\r\\n- Commit the activity-file update through the existing serialized activity writer. Return only after both integration and history persistence finish, so existing card-history reload and diff UI show the integration commit.\\r\\n- If applying or committing the squash fails, restore the primary checkout to its state after the primary-worktree checkpoint and before the squash attempt.\\r\\n- Failed integration writes no activity record. If integration succeeds but activity persistence fails, report that partial failure clearly; never claim tracking succeeded.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Integrating a card worktree with one or several outgoing commits creates and records exactly one squash commit under the card's stable `internalId`.\\r\\n- The squash commit contains the combined change between the project branch and the rebased card branch. Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\\r\\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\\r\\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\\r\\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\\r\\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\\r\\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\\r\\n\\n===== F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_96\\r\\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\\r\\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\\r\\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\\r\\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\\r\\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\\r\\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\\r\\n\\n===== F_98_worktree_vs_project_folder_placeholders.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_98\\r\\ninternalId: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\r\\ntitle: worktree vs project folder placeholders\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\n---\\r\\nWe have 'rootProjectFolder' placeholder. this currently maps to the folder that the agent is running on, so it could the the main project folder or a worktree. \\r\\n\\r\\nWe need to improve this and split it up in `worktree-folder` and 'project-folder' where the last one always references the main project folder while 'worktree-folder' references the folder that the agent is currently running in.\\r\\n\\r\\nAlso, we need to add the 'releases-folder' as well\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` exists in action prompt/command and diff-command placeholder sets.\\r\\n- Action execution resolves it to the execution checkout, which may be the opened project folder or a linked worktree. Diff commands resolve it to the opened project folder.\\r\\n- Action editor insertion controls and user documentation expose only the existing placeholder.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Replace `{{rootProjectFolder}}` everywhere with `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}`; do not keep a legacy alias.\\r\\n- `{{worktree-folder}}` resolves to the absolute execution checkout path. When no linked worktree is selected, it equals `{{project-folder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{project-folder}}` always resolves to the absolute opened repository path, including during linked-worktree execution.\\r\\n- Add `{{releases-folder}}`, resolving to the configured repository-relative releases path: `<projectFolder>/<releasesFolder>`.\\r\\n- Support all three placeholders in action prompts, action commands, prompt preparation, diff commands, editor insertion controls, validation, and documentation.\\r\\n- Fail before process start when a required placeholder value is unavailable. Add tests for primary and linked-worktree execution, custom release paths, diff commands, insertion controls, and removed `{{rootProjectFolder}}` support.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Primary-checkout actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- Linked-worktree actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` to that worktree and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- `{{releases-folder}}` returns the configured path relative to repository root, independent of active checkout.\\r\\n- Action prompts, action commands, and diff commands use the same three folder placeholders.\\r\\n- Editors and documentation list the new placeholders and no longer list `{{rootProjectFolder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` is not resolved.\\r\\n\\n===== J_020_unify_agent_conversation_entries.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-020\\r\\ninternalId: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\ntitle: unify agent conversation messages and events into ordered entries\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - shared/agent_conversations.mjs\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_conversation.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_transcript.js\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/agents/card_agent_state.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: c5d963f2-ca43-419d-bc3c-972199b7e7cd\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace the parallel agent-conversation `messages` and `events` arrays with one canonical ordered `entries` array. Array position is ingestion order and is the only display order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis refactor must land before the action-popup rendering-isolation work. That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\\r\\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\\r\\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe split causes:\\r\\n\\r\\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\\r\\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\\r\\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\\r\\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\\r\\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required model\\r\\n\\r\\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\\r\\n\\r\\n```ts\\r\\n\\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-021\\r\\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\\r\\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\\r\\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\\r\\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\\r\\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\\r\\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`'s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\\r\\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Identity contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\\r\\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\\r\\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\\r\\n- Changing the preview's explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\\r\\n\\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-022\\r\\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\r\\n\\r\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\r\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\r\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\r\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\r\\n\\r\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required ownership\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\r\\n\\r\\n- current Markdown value;\\r\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\r\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\r\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\r\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\r\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\r\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-023\\r\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. A growing conversation and a persisted conversation are the same `AgentConversation`; persistence is only a lifecycle state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current problem\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 unified conversation content into `entries`, but renderer run state still stores `LiveAgentTurn`. `useActionPopupController` converts that object into a new `AgentConversation` during rendering. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\\r\\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\\r\\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\\r\\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation's `entries` without changing entry order.\\r\\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\\r\\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\\r\\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\\r\\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\\r\\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\\r\\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\\r\\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\\r\\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\\r\\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Dependency\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\\r\\n\\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-024\\r\\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\\r\\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\\r\\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\\r\\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\\r\\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\\r\\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\\r\\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Registry shape\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. The map is an internal index, not a React snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach `ActionRunStore` owns one run's status, logs, root action, active chained action, context, conversation, approvals, and question. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - Failed and declined reasoning already use the error presentation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Filter conversation feed activities in `ActionConversationChat`: omit only events where `type === 'reasoning'` and `status === 'completed'`.\\r\\n- Keep in-progress, failed, declined and unknown-status reasoning visible.\\r\\n- Keep completed reasoning events in conversation data and persisted history; this is a presentation-only change.\\r\\n- Update chat tests for live completion, reopened conversations, failed/declined reasoning and unaffected non-reasoning activities.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- In-progress reasoning is visible.\\r\\n- A reasoning block disappears when its status becomes `completed`, including after reopening a conversation.\\r\\n- Failed and declined reasoning remains visible with its error state and content.\\r\\n- Completed non-reasoning activities remain visible.\\r\\n\\n===== F_94_no_prefill_prompt_running_conv.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_94\\r\\ninternalId: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\ntitle: no prefill prompt running conv\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nWhen an agent is waiting for a response, but the action popup was closed or on the wrong 'action', then when the user clicks on the action to view the conversation and answer, the input box is prefilled again with the action's prompt. this is annoying cause it needs to be removed.\\r\\n\\r\\nso, when activating an action that has a running conversation, don't prefill the input\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`useActionPopupController` prepares an action's stored prompt for a new conversation. When popup opens on another action, or reopens while execution state is being restored, that prepared prompt can remain in `promptState` when user selects action with a `queued`, `running`, or `waitingForInput` conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Give active execution its own prompt identity, including before active-child metadata arrives.\\r\\n- When active action is selected, seed editor only from its shared user-entered draft; otherwise show empty input.\\r\\n- Invalidate pending prompt preparation and bump `promptResetToken` when action becomes active.\\r\\n- Keep stored-prompt prefill for idle actions starting new conversations. Keep command actions unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\\r\\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\\r\\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\\r\\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\\r\\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\\r\\n\\n===== F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_95\\r\\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\\r\\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. Only action executions add commit references, so commits integrated from the selector are absent unless an action already recorded them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add a card-specific integration request containing `cardInternalId` and `projectFolder`; project-level worktree integration remains untracked.\\r\\n- After any rebase, squash the card branch's complete change onto the project branch and create one integration commit. Do not model it as a user action.\\r\\n- Commit the activity-file update through the existing serialized activity writer. Return only after both integration and history persistence finish, so existing card-history reload and diff UI show the integration commit.\\r\\n- If applying or committing the squash fails, restore the primary checkout to its state after the primary-worktree checkpoint and before the squash attempt.\\r\\n- Failed integration writes no activity record. If integration succeeds but activity persistence fails, report that partial failure clearly; never claim tracking succeeded.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Integrating a card worktree with one or several outgoing commits creates and records exactly one squash commit under the card's stable `internalId`.\\r\\n- The squash commit contains the combined change between the project branch and the rebased card branch. Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\\r\\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\\r\\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\\r\\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\\r\\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\\r\\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\\r\\n\\n===== F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_96\\r\\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\\r\\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\\r\\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\\r\\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\\r\\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\\r\\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\\r\\n\\n===== F_98_worktree_vs_project_folder_placeholders.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_98\\r\\ninternalId: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\r\\ntitle: worktree vs project folder placeholders\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\n---\\r\\nWe have 'rootProjectFolder' placeholder. this currently maps to the folder that the agent is running on, so it could the the main project folder or a worktree. \\r\\n\\r\\nWe need to improve this and split it up in `worktree-folder` and 'project-folder' where the last one always references the main project folder while 'worktree-folder' references the folder that the agent is currently running in.\\r\\n\\r\\nAlso, we need to add the 'releases-folder' as well\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` exists in action prompt/command and diff-command placeholder sets.\\r\\n- Action execution resolves it to the execution checkout, which may be the opened project folder or a linked worktree. Diff commands resolve it to the opened project folder.\\r\\n- Action editor insertion controls and user documentation expose only the existing placeholder.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Replace `{{rootProjectFolder}}` everywhere with `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}`; do not keep a legacy alias.\\r\\n- `{{worktree-folder}}` resolves to the absolute execution checkout path. When no linked worktree is selected, it equals `{{project-folder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{project-folder}}` always resolves to the absolute opened repository path, including during linked-worktree execution.\\r\\n- Add `{{releases-folder}}`, resolving to the configured repository-relative releases path: `<projectFolder>/<releasesFolder>`.\\r\\n- Support all three placeholders in action prompts, action commands, prompt preparation, diff commands, editor insertion controls, validation, and documentation.\\r\\n- Fail before process start when a required placeholder value is unavailable. Add tests for primary and linked-worktree execution, custom release paths, diff commands, insertion controls, and removed `{{rootProjectFolder}}` support.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Primary-checkout actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- Linked-worktree actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` to that worktree and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- `{{releases-folder}}` returns the configured path relative to repository root, independent of active checkout.\\r\\n- Action prompts, action commands, and diff commands use the same three folder placeholders.\\r\\n- Editors and documentation list the new placeholders and no longer list `{{rootProjectFolder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` is not resolved.\\r\\n\\n===== J_020_unify_agent_conversation_entries.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-020\\r\\ninternalId: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\ntitle: unify agent conversation messages and events into ordered entries\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - shared/agent_conversations.mjs\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_conversation.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_transcript.js\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/agents/card_agent_state.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: c5d963f2-ca43-419d-bc3c-972199b7e7cd\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace the parallel agent-conversation `messages` and `events` arrays with one canonical ordered `entries` array. Array position is ingestion order and is the only display order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis refactor must land before the action-popup rendering-isolation work. That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\\r\\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\\r\\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe split causes:\\r\\n\\r\\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\\r\\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\\r\\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\\r\\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\\r\\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required model\\r\\n\\r\\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\\r\\n\\r\\n```ts\\r\\n\\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-021\\r\\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\\r\\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\\r\\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\\r\\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\\r\\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\\r\\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`'s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\\r\\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Identity contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\\r\\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\\r\\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\\r\\n- Changing the preview's explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\\r\\n\\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-022\\r\\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\r\\n\\r\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\r\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\r\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\r\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\r\\n\\r\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required ownership\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\r\\n\\r\\n- current Markdown value;\\r\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\r\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\r\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\r\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\r\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\r\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-023\\r\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. A growing conversation and a persisted conversation are the same `AgentConversation`; persistence is only a lifecycle state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current problem\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 unified conversation content into `entries`, but renderer run state still stores `LiveAgentTurn`. `useActionPopupController` converts that object into a new `AgentConversation` during rendering. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\\r\\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\\r\\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\\r\\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation's `entries` without changing entry order.\\r\\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\\r\\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\\r\\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\\r\\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\\r\\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\\r\\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\\r\\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\\r\\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\\r\\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Dependency\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\\r\\n\\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-024\\r\\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\\r\\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\\r\\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\\r\\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\\r\\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\\r\\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\\r\\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Registry shape\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. The map is an internal index, not a React snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach `ActionRunStore` owns one run's status, logs, root action, active chained action, context, conversation, approvals, and question. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÃ‚Â² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÃ‚Â² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÃ‚Â² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÃ‚Â² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - Failed and declined reasoning already use the error presentation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Filter conversation feed activities in `ActionConversationChat`: omit only events where `type === 'reasoning'` and `status === 'completed'`.\\r\\n- Keep in-progress, failed, declined and unknown-status reasoning visible.\\r\\n- Keep completed reasoning events in conversation data and persisted history; this is a presentation-only change.\\r\\n- Update chat tests for live completion, reopened conversations, failed/declined reasoning and unaffected non-reasoning activities.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- In-progress reasoning is visible.\\r\\n- A reasoning block disappears when its status becomes `completed`, including after reopening a conversation.\\r\\n- Failed and declined reasoning remains visible with its error state and content.\\r\\n- Completed non-reasoning activities remain visible.\\r\\n\\n===== F_94_no_prefill_prompt_running_conv.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_94\\r\\ninternalId: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\ntitle: no prefill prompt running conv\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nWhen an agent is waiting for a response, but the action popup was closed or on the wrong 'action', then when the user clicks on the action to view the conversation and answer, the input box is prefilled again with the action's prompt. this is annoying cause it needs to be removed.\\r\\n\\r\\nso, when activating an action that has a running conversation, don't prefill the input\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`useActionPopupController` prepares an action's stored prompt for a new conversation. When popup opens on another action, or reopens while execution state is being restored, that prepared prompt can remain in `promptState` when user selects action with a `queued`, `running`, or `waitingForInput` conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Give active execution its own prompt identity, including before active-child metadata arrives.\\r\\n- When active action is selected, seed editor only from its shared user-entered draft; otherwise show empty input.\\r\\n- Invalidate pending prompt preparation and bump `promptResetToken` when action becomes active.\\r\\n- Keep stored-prompt prefill for idle actions starting new conversations. Keep command actions unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\\r\\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\\r\\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\\r\\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\\r\\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\\r\\n\\n===== F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_95\\r\\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\\r\\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. Only action executions add commit references, so commits integrated from the selector are absent unless an action already recorded them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add a card-specific integration request containing `cardInternalId` and `projectFolder`; project-level worktree integration remains untracked.\\r\\n- After any rebase, squash the card branch's complete change onto the project branch and create one integration commit. Do not model it as a user action.\\r\\n- Commit the activity-file update through the existing serialized activity writer. Return only after both integration and history persistence finish, so existing card-history reload and diff UI show the integration commit.\\r\\n- If applying or committing the squash fails, restore the primary checkout to its state after the primary-worktree checkpoint and before the squash attempt.\\r\\n- Failed integration writes no activity record. If integration succeeds but activity persistence fails, report that partial failure clearly; never claim tracking succeeded.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Integrating a card worktree with one or several outgoing commits creates and records exactly one squash commit under the card's stable `internalId`.\\r\\n- The squash commit contains the combined change between the project branch and the rebased card branch. Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\\r\\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\\r\\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\\r\\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\\r\\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\\r\\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\\r\\n\\n===== F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_96\\r\\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\\r\\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\\r\\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\\r\\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\\r\\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\\r\\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\\r\\n\\n===== F_98_worktree_vs_project_folder_placeholders.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_98\\r\\ninternalId: ff356504-eed4-47f3-bb38-2c749b6fcba6\\r\\ntitle: worktree vs project folder placeholders\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\\r\\n---\\r\\nWe have 'rootProjectFolder' placeholder. this currently maps to the folder that the agent is running on, so it could the the main project folder or a worktree. \\r\\n\\r\\nWe need to improve this and split it up in `worktree-folder` and 'project-folder' where the last one always references the main project folder while 'worktree-folder' references the folder that the agent is currently running in.\\r\\n\\r\\nAlso, we need to add the 'releases-folder' as well\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` exists in action prompt/command and diff-command placeholder sets.\\r\\n- Action execution resolves it to the execution checkout, which may be the opened project folder or a linked worktree. Diff commands resolve it to the opened project folder.\\r\\n- Action editor insertion controls and user documentation expose only the existing placeholder.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Replace `{{rootProjectFolder}}` everywhere with `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}`; do not keep a legacy alias.\\r\\n- `{{worktree-folder}}` resolves to the absolute execution checkout path. When no linked worktree is selected, it equals `{{project-folder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{project-folder}}` always resolves to the absolute opened repository path, including during linked-worktree execution.\\r\\n- Add `{{releases-folder}}`, resolving to the configured repository-relative releases path: `<projectFolder>/<releasesFolder>`.\\r\\n- Support all three placeholders in action prompts, action commands, prompt preparation, diff commands, editor insertion controls, validation, and documentation.\\r\\n- Fail before process start when a required placeholder value is unavailable. Add tests for primary and linked-worktree execution, custom release paths, diff commands, insertion controls, and removed `{{rootProjectFolder}}` support.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Primary-checkout actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- Linked-worktree actions resolve `{{worktree-folder}}` to that worktree and `{{project-folder}}` to the opened repository path.\\r\\n- `{{releases-folder}}` returns the configured path relative to repository root, independent of active checkout.\\r\\n- Action prompts, action commands, and diff commands use the same three folder placeholders.\\r\\n- Editors and documentation list the new placeholders and no longer list `{{rootProjectFolder}}`.\\r\\n- `{{rootProjectFolder}}` is not resolved.\\r\\n\\n===== J_020_unify_agent_conversation_entries.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-020\\r\\ninternalId: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\ntitle: unify agent conversation messages and events into ordered entries\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - shared/agent_conversations.mjs\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_conversation.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_transcript.js\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/agents/card_agent_state.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: c5d963f2-ca43-419d-bc3c-972199b7e7cd\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace the parallel agent-conversation `messages` and `events` arrays with one canonical ordered `entries` array. Array position is ingestion order and is the only display order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis refactor must land before the action-popup rendering-isolation work. That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\\r\\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\\r\\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\\r\\n\\r\\nThe split causes:\\r\\n\\r\\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\\r\\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\\r\\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\\r\\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\\r\\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required model\\r\\n\\r\\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\\r\\n\\r\\n```ts\\r\\n\\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-021\\r\\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\\r\\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\\r\\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\\r\\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\\r\\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\\r\\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`'s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\\r\\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Identity contract\\r\\n\\r\\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\\r\\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\\r\\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\\r\\n- Changing the preview's explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Testing implications\\r\\n\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\\r\\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\\r\\n\\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-022\\r\\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current architecture\\r\\n\\r\\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\\r\\n\\r\\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\\r\\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\\r\\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\\r\\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\\r\\n\\r\\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required ownership\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\\r\\n\\r\\n- current Markdown value;\\r\\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\\r\\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\\r\\n- local edit without React parent state;\\r\\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\\r\\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\\r\\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\\r\\n\\r\\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-023\\r\\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. A growing conversation and a persisted conversation are the same `AgentConversation`; persistence is only a lifecycle state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current problem\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 unified conversation content into `entries`, but renderer run state still stores `LiveAgentTurn`. `useActionPopupController` converts that object into a new `AgentConversation` during rendering. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\\r\\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\\r\\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\\r\\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation's `entries` without changing entry order.\\r\\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\\r\\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\\r\\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\\r\\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\\r\\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\\r\\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\\r\\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\\r\\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\\r\\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Dependency\\r\\n\\r\\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\\r\\n\\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: J-024\\r\\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\\r\\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\\r\\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\\r\\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\\r\\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\n  checkLinting: true\\r\\n  requireTests: true\\r\\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Goal\\r\\n\\r\\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Terminology\\r\\n\\r\\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\\r\\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\\r\\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\\r\\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\\r\\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\\r\\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Registry shape\\r\\n\\r\\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. The map is an internal index, not a React snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\nEach `ActionRunStore` owns one run's status, logs, root action, active chained action, context, conversation, approvals, and question. We had a card where the 'custom prompt' action had a conversation that was in the state 'waitingForInput', but no 'stop' or 'ready' buttons are available to mark the conversation as done.

Note: the application had stopped and restarted, so the agent itself was no longer running and everything was loaded from log

This has been seen on regular action for cards as well: when the app is restarted, the 'waitingForInput' state is shown on the 'run' button on the card, but on the action-popup, no 'finish' or 'stop' buttons.

## Current state

`ActionConversationStore` selects the latest persisted `waitingForInput` conversation after restart. Chat and card controls use that persisted status, but `ActionPopupBottomRow` shows Stop and Finish only from a live `ActionRunRegistry` run. Restart suspends the agent and preserves the waiting conversation, while the old run and process no longer exist.

## Implementation details

- When selected conversation is `waitingForInput` and no live run exists, show Stop and Finish. Keep Send available so user can continue conversation.
- Add one Electron/remote bridge operation that atomically reloads conversation by reference and changes only a persisted waiting conversation: Finish sets `completed`; Stop sets `cancelled`; both set `completedAt`. Return updated conversation so renderer stores refresh immediately.
- Keep existing live-run Stop and Finish paths unchanged. Reject missing, malformed, or no-longer-waiting conversations and report failure through `dialogService`.
- Add renderer tests for custom-prompt and regular actions after reload, plus bridge/backend tests for both terminal statuses, timestamp persistence, unchanged conversation data, and rejection of stale state.

## Acceptance criteria

- After restart, persisted waiting custom-prompt and regular-action conversations show enabled Stop, Finish, and Send controls.
- Finish or Stop updates persisted status and `completedAt`; popup and card waiting state clear without an agent process.
- Reload keeps terminal state. Live runs still use normal process controls, and no running conversation can be overwritten by orphan handling.

---

the action-agent-selectors on the action-popup are only enabled when the conversation has not yet started. It is not possible to change a model setting in the middle of a conversation.

This should not be the case. When a conversation has started and the agent is no longer working (so waiting for input from the user), then it is always possible to restart the agent with a different model or security setting and reload the conversation.

The selectors should be disabled while the agent is working (producing output)

## Current state

`ActionAgentSelectorsOwner` treats `queued`, `running`, and `waitingForInput` as one active session and disables every agent selector. `runPopupAction` also sends follow-up text directly to the existing streaming process while waiting, so changed run settings would not be applied.

Conversation checkpoints already contain the path and provider sessions needed to continue through a newly started agent process. `ActionAgentExecutor` resolves model and security overrides when that process starts.

## implementation details

- Disable selectors only while status is `queued` or `running`; enable them during `waitingForInput`.
- Record selector changes made while waiting. Do not restart agent when selection changes.
- On next Send, keep current direct-message path when settings did not change. When settings changed, finish idle streaming run, wait for terminal persistence, then start normal continuation from its conversation path with current agent, model, thinking, access, and approval settings.
- Never run two processes for same conversation concurrently. Keep prompt intact if finishing or restarting fails, and report error through `dialogService`.
- Keep selectors disabled for unsupported capabilities and preserve question and approval blocking rules.
- Add renderer tests for selector status and unchanged-versus-changed follow-up paths; add bridge/backend coverage for ordered finish, reload, and restart.

## acceptance criteria

- Agent selectors are enabled whenever conversation waits for user input and disabled while agent is queued or producing output.
- Changing selector while waiting does not immediately restart agent.
- Next Send restarts agent with changed settings and continues same conversation, including existing transcript.
- Sending without changed settings continues through existing process.
- Restart waits for old process and conversation persistence; no overlapping conversation turn occurs.
- Restart failure preserves unsent prompt and shows error.
